topic: SBI Group's actual equity exposure to Ripple and operational XRP use

sbi_ripple_equity.status: SBI official presentation describes approx 9% of Ripple shares and largest external shareholder; SBI chairman reiterated approx 9% in Feb 2026.
sbi_ripple_equity.not_xrp_tokens: SBI publicly corrected a $10B XRP-holdings rumor: its disclosed exposure is Ripple Labs equity, not $10B of XRP tokens.
sbi_ripple_equity.valuation: Do not multiply by Ripple's latest private valuation and present the result as liquid or realized capital; this is an unlisted equity stake with unknown current fair value, liquidity and exact fully diluted percentage.

sbi_remit_xrp.status: SBI official materials state SBI Remit began international remittance utilizing XRP as a bridge currency in 2021.
sbi_remit_xrp.earlier_ripple_dlt_corridors: SBI Remit reports Ripple DLT remittance corridors Japan-Thailand in 2017 and Japan-Vietnam in 2019.
sbi_remit_xrp.volume: Current XRP-routed remittance volumes, corridor split and net XRP inventory are not disclosed in the reviewed source.

sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.ripple_equity: Approx. 9% Ripple Labs equity; not XRP token inventory.
sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.circle_equity: $50M Circle IPO investment disclosed by SBI Holdings/SBI Shinsei in 2025 ($25M each).
sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.circle_jv: 50:50 Circle SBI Japan JV for USDC distribution.
sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.rlusd: SBI VC Trade listed RLUSD in Japan on 2026-06-24.
sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.xrp_rewards: SBI/Aplus/Visa card points can be converted to XRP, BTC or ETH; XRP redemption share/volume undisclosed.
sbi_group_multi_asset_positions.ai: SBI Group's AlpacaTech/FOLIO subsidiary runs MixSeek, a multi-agent platform supporting ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok.

sbic_disambiguation.separate_entity: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan), corporate number 9011001030621.
sbic_disambiguation.relationship: No ownership/control link to SBI Holdings established in reviewed official sources.
sbic_disambiguation.chatgpt: SBIC seminars are educational; SBI Holdings/SBI Securities enterprise ChatGPT deployment and SBI Group MixSeek are separate SBI Group activities.

causal_interpretation.hypothesis: SBI Group has a strategic portfolio and operating network across Ripple equity/XRP payment rails, Circle equity/USDC, Ripple RLUSD, and multi-model AI infrastructure.
causal_interpretation.classification: Inference supported by multiple disclosed investments, JVs, product listings and operating services; it does not prove a coordinated XRP price-support or accumulation strategy.
disconfirming: SBI invests in Circle as well as Ripple, indicating multi-asset exposure rather than exclusivity.
SBI's Ripple equity stake is corporate equity, not token inventory.
Current XRP remittance volume and card redemptions are undisclosed.
SBIC East Japan is a separate company.
